composing_units: 505th Parachute Infantry Regiment; 507th Parachute Infantry Regiment; 508th Parachute Infantry Regiment; 325th Glider Infantry Regiment
engaged_with: German 91st Luftlande Division; German 709th Static Infantry Division
notes: Dropped west of Sainte-Mere-Eglise from ~01:30 (scattered); 3rd Bn 505th PIR captured the town by 04:30. 507th/508th (under 2nd Airborne Brigade HQ) were not organic to the division.

current_activity: forcing Merderet crossing and linking with 507th PIR
notes: 325th Glider Infantry, with tanks, forced a crossing of the Merderet and linked with isolated 507th PIR pockets, extending the line west to Chef-du-Pont.

current_activity: capturing Montebourg Station to support 4th Division
notes: 505th PIR captured Montebourg Station on 10 June, supporting 4th Division attack.

current_activity: capturing Baupte after crossing the Douve
notes: 508th PIR crossed the Douve at Beuzeville-la-Bastille on 12 June and captured Baupte on 13 June; linked with 101st Airborne 14 June.
325th Glider and 505th PIR passed through 90th Division and captured Saint-Sauveur-le-Vicomte on 16 June.

location_name: Douve bridgehead south of Pont-l-Abbe (toward La Haye-du-Puits)
current_activity: attacking south of Pont-l'Abbé to form bridgehead
notes: CMH: the 82nd was ordered to attack south on 17 June to establish a bridgehead south of Pont-l'Abbe about a mile and a half deep; Wikipedia dates the bridgehead to 19 June after assignment to VIII Corps. Possibly successive phases of one action; kept as disputed.

current_activity: establishing Douve bridgehead south of Pont-l'Abbé (19 June claim)
notes: Division assigned to VIII Corps 19 June; 507th PIR established a bridgehead over the Douve south of Pont-l'Abbe (Wikipedia). CMH dates the 82nd's attack to establish that bridgehead from 17 June (conflict G007; the claims may describe successive phases). Coordinate corrected in v2 to Pont-l'Abbe / Etienville (v1 pointed at La Haye-du-Puits).
